Definition: properly, to cover with pieces; i.e. (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to patch, spot, be spotted, be coloured; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to spot; 1a2) spotted (participle); 1b) (Pual) to be patched
